results.name: Header offers a large unnamed preset palette instead of free color inputs on every page
Preset choices save automatically and independently for page and menu after reload
White and black preset backgrounds keep main and menu text independently readable
Saving ordinary player settings preserves both preset choices and needs no free color input
Each default reset leaves the other saved color and account preferences unchanged
Keyboard navigation selects presets without submitting game answers and Escape restores focus
Preset panel and independently colored mobile menu fit 360 and 390 pixel screens
Matching inline book favicon decodes and the frozen build has no browser errors or external requests

limitations: Account identity and cloud transport are synthetic fixtures; persistence is real browser IndexedDB.
No hosted Supabase authentication, actual cross-device cloud sync or physical device was used.
Favicon link and SVG decoding were tested; browser chrome screenshot rendering itself is outside page automation.
